Westridge marine Terminal  The Trans Mountain Pipeline Company was established in 1951 to construct and operate the Trans Mountain Pipeline between Strathcona County, AB and Burnaby BC. The pipeline and terminals began operation in 1953, creating a reliable energy supply for Canada and the United States. During that period, average daily throughput has been progressively increased from 150,000 barrels per day (BPD) to today’s 300,000 BPD._x000D_
_x000D_
The Westridge Marine Terminal is the western coastal loading and shipping facility for the Trans Mountain Pipeline. It is an existing facility that was built in 1953 and first put into operation in 1957, and exports crude oil products to California and Asia, and distributes jet fuel imported from Washington State refineries to Vancouver International Airport.

searchResults.description: This is a new container terminal proposed by Port Metro Vancouver at Roberts Bank in Delta, BC, approximately 35 kilometres south of Vancouver. The proposed Project is a new three-berth marine container terminal that would provide additional capacity of 2.4 million Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEUs) of containers per year to meet anticipated demand until 2030.

searchResults.description: GCT Canada Limited Partnership proposes to expand the existing marine shipping facility at the GCT Deltaport Terminal with Berth Four, a marine terminal located approximately 12 kilometres southwest from Delta, B.C. The proposed project is anticipated to increase the international shipping capacity of the facility to up to two million twenty-foot shipping containers per year. It will include the expansion of the existing terminal container storage and handling area, the addition of a fourth berth on the southeast side of the Roberts Bank Causeway, and expansion of the existing intermodal rail yard. It would include a 44-hectare expansion of the terminal for container handling and storage, a 560 metres berth extension, a 12 hectare expansion of the existing intermodal rail yard, and a barge berth to accommodate future potential demand for short distance sea shipping capability.
searchResults.name: GCT Deltaport Expansion - Berth Four
